claims.promise: Provisioned capabilities, exact Origin and CSRF separate observers from writers.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: TLS trust and credential provisioning are external.
claims.invalidatedBy: Compromised browser/host, stolen credentials or incorrect configured Origin.

claims.promise: Secure bounded sessions expire and can be revoked; audit omits credential text.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Already delivered bytes are not recalled.
claims.invalidatedBy: Caller bypasses Gate or fails to close an expired transport.

claims.promise: Service starts detached; exact instance/revision approval is consumed once.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Approval is a trusted operator assertion.
claims.invalidatedBy: Operator approves the wrong guest line or its process changes without observable identity loss.

claims.promise: A supervised connection remains unpublished until connected-socket proof; expiry retires it.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Not a hard real-time guarantee or CPU-stop mechanism.
claims.invalidatedBy: A trusted observer lies, accepts inherited descriptors incorrectly or stops receiving CPU time.

claims.promise: Only the exact next sequence can renew; concurrent contenders have one winner.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Local operator/observer credentials remain trusted.
claims.invalidatedBy: An attacker controls the private socket or approved observer.

claims.promise: Observation grants no keyboard lease; expiry/disconnect does not replay input.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Bytes sent before revocation can already affect the guest.
claims.invalidatedBy: A guest terminal line is mistakenly wired to an operator monitor.

claims.promise: Late reader output and replacement listeners cannot revive a retired bridge.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: An OS change within the surviving stream is invisible.
claims.invalidatedBy: Reuse of a generation outside the manager contract.

claims.promise: Same-count replacement changes the viewer membership identity.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: The single-view guard is a lab policy; normal terminal supports multiple observers.
claims.invalidatedBy: A consumer tracks counts only, or treats a callback as independent OS identification.

claims.promise: Inputs, credits, stalled writes and connection counts remain bounded.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Host-level exhaustion and arbitrary adversarial load are not fully qualified.
claims.invalidatedBy: Callers bypass the bounded handler or future limits are removed.

claims.promise: Listener capacity is released when connections close.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: This is one resource bound, not complete denial-of-service assurance.
claims.invalidatedBy: An outer proxy accepts unbounded work.

claims.promise: Revocation fences pending and pre-HTTP publication; concurrent epoch use has one winner.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Epoch starts at status observation, not the user click.
claims.invalidatedBy: Client silently obtains a fresh epoch and retries without renewed consent.

claims.promise: Every publication gets a distinct receipt; malformed input cannot replace selection.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Legacy /screen permits absent receipt; current clients check exact returned receipt.
claims.invalidatedBy: A consumer ignores the receipt or includes saved excerpts without fresh approval.

claims.promise: Separate TLS credential and fixed model; no management/tools, queued inference or automatic retry.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: A runner may retain submitted data or continue after cancellation.
claims.invalidatedBy: Gateway is pointed at an untrusted provider or its credential is leaked.

claims.promise: Every delivered explanation is qualified; marked unsupported quotations are withheld.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: The label and quotation heuristic do not establish factual correctness.
claims.invalidatedBy: A consumer hides the label, or prose contains an unrecognized unsupported claim.

claims.promise: Unsafe producer change, retained-byte rewrite or completion mismatch retires observed bytes.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Discarded history and malicious ancestor-directory changes are not authenticated.
claims.invalidatedBy: Untrusted producer lies about identity/completion or an ancestor owner replaces paths.

claims.promise: Closed followers cannot reopen; observers receive exact authorized completed exports.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Original CPU/device tests do not qualify an OS printer driver.
claims.invalidatedBy: A producer is incorrectly approved or caller bypasses generation checks.

claims.promise: Private inputs reject unsafe types; control directory must belong to the service.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Foreign-owner mutation cases skip on Mac; separate root Linux run required. Trusted ancestors remain required.
claims.invalidatedBy: Root/ancestor owner is hostile, or provisioning gives another account directory control.

claims.promise: Mandatory installed-service guard refuses absent/excessive memory or swap containment.
claims.evidence: deterministic fixtures unless the packet names an executed Linux check
claims.limitations: Go soft target alone is insufficient. Physical Pi memory controller remains disabled/unqualified.
claims.invalidatedBy: Service launched without mandatory flag, altered unit or controller limits changed after the startup check.

claims.promise: Malformed or stale local approvals fail; an occupied socket is preserved for explicit stopped recovery.
claims.evidence: deterministic local socket fixtures
claims.limitations: Private directory ownership and trusted ancestors provide local authorization; no peer-user multi-tenant policy.
claims.invalidatedBy: Another account controls the socket parent or an operator deletes a live socket.

claims.promise: Handled failures remove only newly created material and preserve unexpected files.
claims.evidence: injected filesystem failures; retained M5.14 Linux file-size refusal
claims.limitations: Not atomic against SIGKILL, power loss or failed cleanup. Original exit-139 incidents remain unexplained.
claims.invalidatedBy: A host crash or hostile parent hierarchy defeats the handled-error assumptions.

claims.promise: Invalid configuration diagnostics do not echo arbitrary private input.
claims.evidence: secret-canary fixture; source review of error paths
claims.limitations: Not a universal proof of zero sensitive logging. Explicit lab captures, downloads, browser history and provider retention are separate stores.
claims.invalidatedBy: Future logging prints requests, private config, console content or provider errors without review.
